name: voice-bridge-live2d-ui
description: Live2D avatar UI for voice-bridge (Electron + React + Cubism Web SDK)
author: zephel01

scripts.start: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n VITE,ELECTRON,TSC -c cyan,magenta,yellow "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 dist-electron/main.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ." "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json -w --preserveWatchOutput"
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run build:electron
